title: Range Sum Query (Prefix Sum)
prompt:
Implement a `NumArray` class that supports efficient range sum queries on an immutable array.

**Approach:** Prefix sum array. Precompute cumulative sums so each query is O(1).

**Requirements:**
1. Define and export class `NumArray` in `solution.ts`
2. `constructor(nums: number[])` -- build a prefix sum array where `prefix[i]` is the sum of `nums[0..i-1]`. Set `prefix[0] = 0`
3. `sumRange(left: number, right: number): number` -- return the sum of elements from index `left` to `right` (inclusive) using `prefix[right + 1] - prefix[left]`

**Examples:**
```typescript
const arr = new NumArray([-2, 0, 3, -5, 2, -1]);
arr.sumRange(0, 2);  //  1  (-2 + 0 + 3)
arr.sumRange(2, 5);  // -1  (3 + -5 + 2 + -1)
arr.sumRange(0, 5);  // -3  (sum of all)
```

**Complexity:** O(n) init time, O(1) per query, O(n) space
hints: A prefix sum array stores cumulative sums: prefix[i] = sum(nums[0..i-1])
Start the prefix array with [0] so that prefix[1] = nums[0]
Build prefix by pushing prefix[prefix.length - 1] + num for each num

solution.ts.name: NumArray
solution.ts.description: Export NumArray as a named export
Define a sumRange method that returns the sum from left to right inclusive
Use a for loop to build the prefix sum array
